modified_caption: The line plot illustrates the relationship between computational power, measured in TFLOPs, and loss ratio in percentage. The x-axis represents TFLOPs and has a custom scale, ranging from 1e7 to 9e8, with tick marks labeled at intervals like 1e7, 2e7, 5e7, 1e8, 2e8, 3e8, 4e8, 5e8, 6e8, 7e8, 8e8, and 9e8. The y-axis represents the loss ratio in percentage, with a linear scale ranging from 94% to 100%, marked at regular intervals of 1. Five lines are depicted in this plot. The purple line with triangle markers and a solid style represents the 'Vanilla' method, which remains constant at 100% across the x-axis. The orange line with line markers represents 'SepLLM (n=64)' and increases from approximately 98% at 1e7 TFLOPs to around 100% at 9e8 TFLOPs, peaking at 102% near 4e8. The blue line with cross markers depicts 'SepLLM (n=128)', starting at about 97% and ending at 99%, with a steady increase. The green line with diamond markers represents 'SepLLM (n=64, H)' and follows a similar pattern, beginning at approximately 97.5% and peaking at 101% before stabilizing at 99%. The red line with round markers shows 'SepLLM (n=64, H/T)', starting at 94%, peaking at around 98% near 4e8 TFLOPs, and declining to 96% near the end of the x-axis. A legend is given at the bottom right.

modifications.claim: The orange line ('SepLLM (n=64)') peaks at 102% near 4e8 TFLOPs.
modifications.reality: The orange line peaks slightly above 100% near 4e8 TFLOPs, not at 102%.

modifications.claim: The green line ('SepLLM (n=64, H)') stabilizes at 99% after peaking at 101%.
modifications.reality: The green line peaks slightly above 100% and ends slightly below 100%, not stabilizing at 99%.

modifications.claim: The red line ('SepLLM (n=64, H/T)') declines to 96% near the end of the x-axis.
modifications.reality: The red line ends at approximately 98.8%, not 96%.
